method: Sequential, unpinned processes on an unreserved host; no concurrent benchmarks or tests. Graph construction alone is timed. Screening and confirmation cases shuffled independently with LCG seeds 19097 and 41197 (1664525*x+1013904223 modulo 2^32, reverse Fisher-Yates). Repeats use uncapped,512,1024,1024,uncapped,512 order. Default byte ceiling 64 MiB for every run. All recorded runs passed independent randomized execution validation.
nonbinding_explanation: Each cached target has at least one logical byte, so 64 MiB permits at most 67108864 entries. The larger target ceiling can never evict an entry; only the byte ceiling can. The bookkeeping for repeated-expense admission is unchanged.
diagnostic_probe: Use the diagnostic_probe string in cache_sizing_results.json; diagnostics must not be used for time or RSS comparisons.
